reason: Test `loop_order` once after fixed-flag compiler inspection. Fresh baseline scores are 1373–1504 GFLOP/s; no current candidate measurements show this change helps. The current order already writes adjacent column tiles for each row tile, so the locality benefit is uncertain and changing traversal may reduce A reuse. The proposal preserves the full increasing-k reduction and four ZA tiles, which keeps correctness risk low if the compiler has not already made the change.
